description: Unmodified pinned Unitree ROS message packages and complete Python SDK source for isolated compatibility testing.

compatibility_notes.response_binary: Pinned unitree_api ROS Response.msg uses int8[] binary; pinned Python SDK Response_ uses sequence[uint8]. Preserved unchanged; actual ROS-to-SDK DDS type matching must be validated before claiming compatibility.
compatibility_notes.execution: Source acquisition does not import or execute the SDK and does not open DDS participants.
